scene1: Most agent memory is a plain document.
Correct the agent and the old belief is deleted.
Hermes cannot say what it thought before, or why it changed.
scene2: A correction is a new line, not an overwrite.
Two corrections in, it derives a rule that cites them.
scene3: Every answer carries the line it came from.
Ask why, and you get a timeline.
scene4: Each line hashes the one before it.
Edit one character and verify names the line that broke.
scene5: The same lines go to Walrus Mainnet.
Sealed before upload. Unreadable without a session.
With a session it opens, and nothing is dropped.
scene6: Seven tools. Ninety-three tests. Zero Python dependencies.
Your agent stops forgetting what it used to believe.
